claim: Construct a concrete rational quaternion carrier with the exact μ²=−210 positive-involution convention, faithful real matrix action, and an explicit Rosati-stable integral order on which the same alternating trace form is perfect.

obligations.name: Concrete algebra, not a curve label
obligations.required_input: The PEL algebra must not be confused with the separate encoding elliptic coefficient or genus-five contact Jacobian.
obligations.constructed_input: B is literally Mathlib QuaternionAlgebra Q(-210,0,5), with μ=i, j²=5, ij=-ji and an explicit μ inverse. Its reduced discriminant210 and identification with the named source algebra still require local classification.
obligations.justification: B is literally Mathlib QuaternionAlgebra Q(-210,0,5), with μ=i, j²=5, ij=-ji and an explicit μ inverse. Its reduced discriminant210 and identification with the named source algebra still require local classification.

obligations.name: Exact positive involution
obligations.required_input: The source convention is μ^-1*bar(x)*μ, not arbitrary conjugation.
obligations.constructed_input: The involution is constructed with that formula, its coordinate signs, anti-multiplication and involutivity proved. Its positive trace is exactly2(r²+210i²+5j²+1050k²) and is strictly positive at every nonzero rational element.
obligations.justification: The involution is constructed with that formula, its coordinate signs, anti-multiplication and involutivity proved. Its positive trace is exactly2(r²+210i²+5j²+1050k²) and is strictly positive at every nonzero rational element.

obligations.name: Same alternating trace form
obligations.required_input: The action and polarization candidate must refer to the same carrier and orientation.
obligations.constructed_input: E(x,y)=Tr(μ^-1*x*bar(y)) is proved bilinear, alternating, nondegenerate, and E(a*x,y)=E(x,rosati(a)*y). No unrelated elliptic Weil pairing or dimension argument supplies this.
obligations.justification: E(x,y)=Tr(μ^-1*x*bar(y)) is proved bilinear, alternating, nondegenerate, and E(a*x,y)=E(x,rosati(a)*y). No unrelated elliptic Weil pairing or dimension argument supplies this.

obligations.name: Faithful real splitting input
obligations.required_input: The analytic period carrier requires an actual algebra hom and the same adjoint.
obligations.constructed_input: The explicit rational quaternion ring hom into real2x2 matrices is proved multiplicative and injective. It sends μ to sqrt210 times the rotation and j to diag(sqrt5,-sqrt5); Rosati maps exactly to transpose.
obligations.justification: The explicit rational quaternion ring hom into real2x2 matrices is proved multiplicative and injective. It sends μ to sqrt210 times the rotation and j to diag(sqrt5,-sqrt5); Rosati maps exactly to transpose.

obligations.name: Actual integral order
obligations.required_input: A rational pairing alone does not construct a PEL lattice.
obligations.constructed_input: The basis1,i,(1+j)/2,i/2+k/10 gives a specified subring through an explicit integral multiplication polynomial. The carrier is exactly the range of the four-integer-coordinate embedding, with an additive equivalence. It contains μ and is stable under the same Rosati involution.
obligations.justification: The basis1,i,(1+j)/2,i/2+k/10 gives a specified subring through an explicit integral multiplication polynomial. The carrier is exactly the range of the four-integer-coordinate embedding, with an additive equivalence. It contains μ and is stable under the same Rosati involution.

obligations.name: Perfect integral pairing
obligations.required_input: Principal-lattice compatibility must be proved, not inferred from rank or integrality.
obligations.constructed_input: The same unrescaled trace form has exact integer Gram[[0,-2,0,-1],[2,0,1,0],[0,-1,0,0],[1,0,0,0]]. Every integral linear functional has an explicitly constructed unique representing coordinate vector. The naive order is separately shown not perfect, preventing substitution of the wrong lattice.
obligations.justification: The same unrescaled trace form has exact integer Gram[[0,-2,0,-1],[2,0,1,0],[0,-1,0,0],[1,0,0,0]]. Every integral linear functional has an explicitly constructed unique representing coordinate vector. The naive order is separately shown not perfect, preventing substitution of the wrong lattice.

obligations.name: Period positivity convention
obligations.required_input: A positive Rosati trace is not yet positivity of a Riemann form for the chosen complex structure.
obligations.constructed_input: This packet retains E and μ unchanged. For the standard upper-half-plane right complex structure, E(x,Jx) is negative; the analytic worker explicitly uses -E, equivalently E(Jx,x). Exact period compatibility and positivity are separate consuming proofs, not hidden sign changes here.
obligations.justification: This packet retains E and μ unchanged. obligations.name: Remaining PEL/Jacobian identification
obligations.required_input: The abelian surface, maximal order, moduli and original contact source must be constructed or compared.
obligations.constructed_input: Reduced-discriminant/maximality classification, compact complex torus and algebraization, represented abelian scheme with order action, determinant condition, principal polarization on that scheme, actual PEL moduli/contact identification and integral KS/Hodge theorem remain separate. Perfect lattice does not establish all those conclusions.

Perfect lattice does not establish all those conclusions.

obligations.required_input: Classical producer hypotheses and formal implementation must remain distinct.

Six new sources and primary QuaternionAlgebra API are bound. Exact rational closure/Gram/adjoint checks support implementation only; no local Lean or full arithmetic claim.
